lines.zh: 我在暖流里摆尾，脂肪替我省力。
lines.en: I beat my tail in the warm current; blubber saves me effort.

lines.zh: 深海的压挤着我，正合我意。
lines.en: Deep-sea pressure squeezes me, exactly as I like.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，一身脂把水推开。
lines.en: I swim slowly, my blubber pushing the water aside.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一摆，温水从鳃边滑过。
lines.en: One tailbeat and warm water slides past my gills.

lines.zh: 我贴着海沟的岩壁游，那里最暖。
lines.en: I swim along the trench wall, the warmest place.

lines.zh: 我绕着热泉转圈，鳞上全是光。
lines.en: I circle the hot vent with light all over my scales.

lines.zh: 我身体太沉，转弯要划三下鳍。
lines.en: I am too heavy and need three fin strokes to turn.

lines.zh: 下面黑，我的影子比我先到。
lines.en: It is dark below, and my shadow arrives before me.

lines.zh: 我随上升的热水漂，不用游。
lines.en: I drift on rising hot water and need not swim.

lines.zh: 我擦过珊瑚尖，脂被刮下一层。
lines.en: I brush a coral tip and a layer of blubber scrapes off.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方水都是温的。
lines.en: The water I pass through stays warm behind me.

lines.zh: 我荡着长大，深海里没什么急事。
lines.en: I grew up drifting; nothing in the deep is urgent.

lines.zh: 冷水下来，我往更深处钻。
lines.en: Cold water sinks, so I dive deeper.

lines.zh: 我摆动全身，像一团会呼吸的油。
lines.en: I undulate like a breathing lump of oil.

lines.zh: 我蹭过岩壁，蹭下一层苔。
lines.en: I scrape along the rock and shave off a layer of moss.

lines.zh: 我慢慢翻身，肚皮朝上漂。
lines.en: I roll over slowly and drift belly up.

lines.zh: 我悬在温水里，什么也不想。
lines.en: I hang in the warm water and think of nothing.

lines.zh: 鳃慢慢开合，我在听海的声音。
lines.en: My gills open and close slowly as I listen to the sea.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，把自己交给洋流。
lines.en: I hold still and give myself to the current.

lines.zh: 深海安静，只有热泉在咕噜。
lines.en: The deep is quiet except for the gurgling vent.

lines.zh: 我在等一块浮下来的碎肉。
lines.en: I am waiting for a scrap of flesh to drift down.

lines.zh: 我憋着气，看气泡往上游。
lines.en: I hold my breath and watch bubbles climb.

lines.zh: 我在暗处发亮，那是脂的反光。
lines.en: I glow in the dark; that is blubber reflecting light.

lines.zh: 我贴着石头，感觉自己像块礁。
lines.en: I press to a rock and feel like a reef myself.

lines.zh: 我想不出比温水更好的事。
lines.en: I can think of nothing better than warm water.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，肚皮朝着热泉。
lines.en: I turn over and point my belly at the vent.

lines.zh: 有东西游过，我懒得动。
lines.en: Something swims past and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 深海里没有白天，我靠肚子算时间。
lines.en: There is no day down here; I keep time by my belly.

lines.zh: 我慢慢下沉，再被暖流托起来。
lines.en: I sink slowly, then the warm current lifts me back.

lines.zh: 我睡了半刻，尾还在动。
lines.en: I doze for a while with my tail still moving.

lines.zh: 你游下来时，我以为是块沉肉。
lines.en: When you swim down, I take you for sinking meat.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的靴子，那东西不像鱼。
lines.en: I stare at your boots; they are no fish.

lines.zh: 你在水里冒泡，我反而好奇。
lines.en: You bubble underwater, which makes me curious.

lines.zh: 我眼珠转了一圈，才看清你有手。
lines.en: My eye rolls once before I see you have hands.

lines.zh: 你靠近，我的鳃张开又合上。
lines.en: You come close and my gills flare and close.

lines.zh: 我看你手脚乱划，觉得可笑。
lines.en: I watch your flailing limbs and find it funny.

lines.zh: 你的灯照到我，鳞上透出橘色。
lines.en: Your light hits me and orange shows through my scales.

lines.zh: 我看你很久，水都被我游温了。
lines.en: I watch you so long the water warms around me.

lines.zh: 你手指一动，我以为要喂我。
lines.en: Your finger moves and I expect to be fed.

lines.zh: 我抬头，正好撞上你的面罩。
lines.en: I look up and bump straight into your mask.

lines.zh: 你在我身上开口，脂往外翻。
lines.en: You open a cut on me and blubber turns outward.

lines.zh: 这一下我疼得乱摆，水全都浑了。
lines.en: The pain makes me thrash and the water clouds.

lines.zh: 血是暖的，散在冷水里很快变凉。
lines.en: My blood is warm, then cools fast in the cold water.

lines.zh: 我拖着伤游，身后一串油花。
lines.en: I swim off wounded, trailing a line of oil.

lines.zh: 你砍到我的背，鳞翻开一片。
lines.en: You cut my back and a sheet of scales peels up.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，伤口在压里更疼。
lines.en: I sink, and the pressure makes the wound worse.

lines.zh: 我张口想咬，可疼得咬不准。
lines.en: I snap at you but hurt too much to aim.

lines.zh: 被划破的地方，水正往里渗。
lines.en: Water seeps into the torn place.

lines.zh: 我甩尾逃走，撞上了岩壁。
lines.en: I flee with a tail flick and hit the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，震得一群小鱼散了。
lines.en: I shudder and a school of small fish scatters.

lines.zh: 彩针糖，深海里哪来这种东西。
lines.en: Sprinkles? Where would such a thing come from down here?

lines.zh: 你掌心的糖一撒，我整条鱼都软了。
lines.en: You scatter sprinkles from your palm and I go limp all over.

lines.zh: 那点甜味顺着水飘过来，我追。
lines.en: A trace of sweetness drifts through the water and I follow.

lines.zh: 我张嘴等糖落进来，别撒偏。
lines.en: I open my mouth for the sprinkles; do not miss.

lines.zh: 糖没到嘴，我肚子先胀了一圈。
lines.en: Before the candy reaches my mouth, my belly swells a ring.

lines.zh: 我绕着你手转，舍不得走。
lines.en: I circle your hand, unwilling to leave.

lines.zh: 再给一颗，我就胖得游不动了。
lines.en: One more and I will be too fat to swim.

lines.zh: 甜味太陌生，可我还是想要。
lines.en: The sweetness is strange, yet I still want it.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张到最大，等你放手。
lines.en: I open my mouth as wide as it goes and wait.

lines.zh: 你晃糖粒，我尾鳍都打结了。
lines.en: You shake the sprinkles and my tail fin knots up.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，水被推得晃了三下。
lines.en: You bump me and the water sways three times.

lines.zh: 我一身脂被挤到一边，弹了回去。
lines.en: My blubber squeezes aside and springs back.

lines.zh: 你的脚碰到我肚子，我滚了一圈。
lines.en: Your foot touches my belly and I roll once.

lines.zh: 别挤，里面全是攒下的脂。
lines.en: Do not press; it is all stored blubber inside.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，像撞进一团温水泥。
lines.en: I hit you like plunging into warm cement.

lines.zh: 我被你顶开，撞在珊瑚上。
lines.en: You shove me off and I hit the coral.

lines.zh: 你一推，我沉下去又浮上来。
lines.en: One push and I sink, then float back up.

lines.zh: 我贴着你，把外衣都弄油了。
lines.en: I press against you and grease your suit.

lines.zh: 我撞得太响，热泉边的鱼都散了。
lines.en: I hit hard enough that fish scatter from the vent.

lines.zh: 被挤得紧了，我肚子会响一声。
lines.en: Squeezed tight, my belly gives one loud sound.

lines.zh: 我们两条一起浮，脂把水流挡得严。
lines.en: We two float together, our blubber blocking the flow.

lines.zh: 我绕着它游，尾巴扫它肚子。
lines.en: I circle it and sweep its belly with my tail.

lines.zh: 它也胖，我们在暖流里互相蹭。
lines.en: It is fat too, and we rub against each other in the warm current.

lines.zh: 我把糖渣吐给它，它全吃了。
lines.en: I spit candy bits to it and it eats them all.

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起，像两块融化的油。
lines.en: We press together like two melting lumps of oil.

lines.zh: 它一摆尾，我就跟上去。
lines.en: One flick of its tail and I follow.

lines.zh: 深海没有季节，我们只是靠得近。
lines.en: The deep has no seasons; we simply stay close.

lines.zh: 我用吻碰它的吻，水里没声音。
lines.en: I touch my snout to its snout, silent underwater.

lines.zh: 它比我圆，我追了很久才追上。
lines.en: It is rounder than me, and I chase a long time to catch it.

lines.zh: 我们并排沉下热泉，谁也不游。
lines.en: We sink side by side by the vent, neither swimming.

lines.zh: 我叼不住东西，嘴太软。
lines.en: I cannot hold things; my mouth is too soft.

lines.zh: 有食落下来，我一口吞了进去。
lines.en: Food drifts down and I swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 我用鳍碰它，它沉得比我还快。
lines.en: I touch it with a fin and it sinks faster than I do.

lines.zh: 捡不了，我只能把它咽下去。
lines.en: I cannot pick it up, so I swallow it.

lines.zh: 我试着含住，结果吞了一半。
lines.en: I try to hold it and end up swallowing half.

lines.zh: 东西落在沙上，我啃了沙。
lines.en: It lands on sand and I chew sand with it.

lines.zh: 我肚皮贴着它，把它压进泥。
lines.en: I press my belly on it and push it into the mud.

lines.zh: 我分不清石头和糖，都试一口。
lines.en: I cannot tell stone from candy, so I try both.

lines.zh: 它太硬，我吐出来又咽回去。
lines.en: It is too hard; I spit it out and swallow it again.

lines.zh: 吞下去的糖在肚里还发甜。
lines.en: The candy I swallowed still tastes sweet inside.

lines.zh: 有东西动得太快，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Something moves too fast, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我只吃肉，可我得先追上。
lines.en: I eat only meat, but first I must catch it.

lines.zh: 它擦过我的鳃，我转身了。
lines.en: It brushes my gills and I turn around.

lines.zh: 我看见了闪光，就去撞它。
lines.en: I see a glint and ram it.

lines.zh: 海底很少有猎物，我不放过。
lines.en: Prey is rare on the seabed, so I let none go.

lines.zh: 我慢，但我只要一次机会。
lines.en: I am slow, but I need only one chance.

lines.zh: 它比我小，我张嘴就够了。
lines.en: It is smaller than me; opening my mouth is enough.

lines.zh: 我闻到血，知道了方向。
lines.en: I smell blood and know the direction.

lines.zh: 我把尾压低，准备冲那一下。
lines.en: I lower my tail and prepare one charge.

lines.zh: 它躲到岩石后，我绕着等。
lines.en: It hides behind a rock and I circle, waiting.

lines.zh: 我悬着不动，让热水从我背上过。
lines.en: I hang still and let hot water pass over my back.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，鳃张得比平时大。
lines.en: I stare at it with gills wider than usual.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，水推向它。
lines.en: One tailbeat pushes the water at it.

lines.zh: 它游得比我快，我只能堵。
lines.en: It swims faster than me, so I can only block.

lines.zh: 我把身子横过来，挡住它的路。
lines.en: I turn broadside to cut off its path.

lines.zh: 我鼓了鼓，不是要炸，是吓它。
lines.en: I swell a little, not to burst, but to scare it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转，眼睛一直没离开它。
lines.en: I turn slowly, eyes never leaving it.

lines.zh: 它想往上跑，我先到了。
lines.en: It tries to flee upward and I am already there.

lines.zh: 我不出声，深海里的沉默最吓人。
lines.en: I make no sound; deep-sea silence frightens most.

lines.zh: 我贴到岩石上，等它经过。
lines.en: I flatten against the rock and wait for it to pass.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，整团脂压住它。
lines.en: I ram it and my whole mass of blubber pins it.

lines.zh: 我咬住它，牙齿钝，可劲够。
lines.en: I bite down; my teeth are blunt but my strength is not.

lines.zh: 我把它掀翻，软的东西容易沉。
lines.en: I flip it over; soft things sink easily.

lines.zh: 这一撞我自己也晕了半刻。
lines.en: The impact dazes me for a moment too.

lines.zh: 我压住它，等它不再动。
lines.en: I lie on it until it stops moving.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴抽，水都被打得发闷。
lines.en: I lash with my tail and the water thuds.

lines.zh: 我咬破了皮，血在暖水里散开。
lines.en: I break its skin and blood blooms in the warm water.

lines.zh: 它挣了一下，我只好再撞一次。
lines.en: It struggles once, so I ram again.

lines.zh: 我太重，扑过去就压塌了一片沙。
lines.en: I am so heavy my lunge collapses the sand.

lines.zh: 我吞下它的大半，剩下的沉了。
lines.en: I swallow most of it; the rest sinks.

lines.zh: 我在热泉边出生，水正好温。
lines.en: I am born by the hot vent, in water just warm enough.

lines.zh: 第一次摆尾，我撞到了石壁。
lines.en: My first tailbeat knocks me into the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我自带一层脂，深海也冻不着。
lines.en: I come with blubber; the deep cannot freeze me.

lines.zh: 睁开眼就是黑水，我不怕。
lines.en: I open my eyes on black water and feel no fear.

lines.zh: 我游得歪，撞了几次才算学会。
lines.en: I swim crooked and only learn after several collisions.

lines.zh: 出生时我比气泡还轻。
lines.en: At birth I am lighter than a bubble.

lines.zh: 这里没有浅滩，只有往下的黑。
lines.en: There is no shallows here, only darkness below.

lines.zh: 我把第一口热水吞进肚里。
lines.en: I swallow my first mouthful of hot water.

lines.zh: 我找热泉，那是我的床。
lines.en: I look for the hot vent; that is my bed.

lines.zh: 我生下来就胖，游得比谁都慢。
lines.en: I am born fat and swim slower than anyone.

lines.zh: 水里火进不来，可你还是点着了我。
lines.en: Fire cannot enter water, yet you still set me alight.

lines.zh: 我从水里被抛起，落地时像摔一袋油。
lines.en: Tossed from the water, I land like a dropped sack of oil.

lines.zh: 水里我本该能呼吸，现在鳃里进了沙。
lines.en: I should breathe here, but sand has filled my gills.

lines.zh: 炸开的压力把我推得翻了身。
lines.en: Pressure from the burst rolls me belly-up.

lines.zh: 箭穿过水，扎进我厚脂里。
lines.en: An arrow cuts through the water and sinks into my blubber.

lines.zh: 魔法的光透了进来，我的脂发寒。
lines.en: Magic light pierces me and my blubber turns cold.

lines.zh: 深海里吃得太少，我开始瘦下去。
lines.en: I eat too little in the deep and begin to thin.

lines.zh: 电流在水里散开，我整条都僵了。
lines.en: Current spreads through the water and I go rigid.

lines.zh: 水没有了，我在虚空的冷里瘪掉。
lines.en: The water is gone and I shrivel in the void's cold.
